{"id":2056449070,"question_id":4346,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 4 days","timestamp":1783222464,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"12 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2056449070/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Subsequence After One Replacement","memory":"41.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool canMakeSubsequence(string s, string t) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        int m = t.size();\n\n        vector<int>pref(n+1 , -1);\n        pref[0] = 0;\n        int j = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            if(pref[i] == -1) break;\n            while(j<m and s[i] != t[j]) j++;\n            if(j < m){\n                pref[i+1] = j+1;\n                j++;\n            }\n            else pref[i+1] = -1;\n        }\n\n        vector<int>suff(n+1 , -1);\n        suff[n] = m;\n        j = m-1;\n\n        for(int i = n-1 ; i>=0 ; i--){\n            if(suff[i+1] == -1) break;\n            while(j>=0 and s[i] != t[j]) j--;\n            if(j >= 0){\n                suff[i] = j;\n                j--;\n            }\n            else suff[i] = -1;\n        }\n\n        if(pref[n] != -1) return true;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            if(pref[i] == -1) break;\n            if(pref[i] >= m) continue;\n            if(suff[i+1] == -1) continue;\n            if(pref[i] + 1 <= suff[i+1]) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"subsequence-after-one-replacement","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2299}
